svg.title: WiBoat two-layer mesh architecture
svg.desc: Two mesh layers: short-range 5GHz WiFi mesh between nearby boats enabling multistatic radar, and long-range LoRa Meshtastic mesh for position and alert sharing up to 10km
svg.text: Two-layer mesh — short and long range
868/915 MHz · up to 10 km · low power

g.text: No AIS · detected by WiFi CSI
